title: 数据与恢复（统一修订）
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Use the provided SETTINGS image as the exact style/navigation/frame reference and create its 数据与恢复 tab. Keep the same single left sidebar and header geometry, same readable Chinese, blue-gray palette, full desktop canvas, no browser chrome.
The settings tabs MUST be exactly these four in this exact order: "偏好" / "提醒与连接" / "数据与恢复" / "清单管理". Select ONLY 数据与恢复, third tab. Do not invent 通用/通知/专注 tabs. No 保存偏好 button. Header is 设置, with secondary 导出JSON and导出ICS actions.
Main section "导入数据", subtitle "导入导出任务、目标、习惯与关联记录" — do NOT claim exporting Markdown document bodies.
One aligned file/target toolbar: 选择文件, tasks.csv, 文件类型CSV, 导入到工作与创造, 预览导入. A READ-ONLY preview table labeled "23项 · 第1页/共3页", columns类型/标题/日期/归属, TEN readable task rows, all assigned工作与创造 because that target was chosen. Use plausible dates Nov4–Nov10,2026. Row8 title优化项目首页文案 has date badge "未安排" in amber. There are NO selectable-row checkboxes or completion controls in this preview table.
One warning "第8项日期无法解析，将按未安排任务导入；如需保留日期，请修改源文件后重新预览。" This is nonfatal: ALL23 tasks can be imported, including the one with no date. Never say only22 can import or that correction is mandatory while enabling import. Pagination1/2/3 under table.
Footer helper "修改文件或目标清单后需重新预览" and primary "确认导入23项". A compact collapsed 历史导入作业 area, truthful note "停止不会撤销已完成批次". Keep the whole screen tidy and readable, all primary actions inside viewport; no task detail pane, no secrets, no JSON, no watermark.
